# Spark your next story with DeepSeek in 5 minutes

**Hook:** You’ll walk away with three ready-to-use story starters you can drop into any blank page. No writing experience needed—just curiosity and a few clicks.

## Before you start
- A free DeepSeek account (sign up at [deepseek.ai](https://deepseek.ai)).
- A blank page or doc to paste your ideas.

## Step 1 — Open a fresh chat
1. Go to [chat.deepseek.ai](https://chat.deepseek.ai).
2. Click “New Chat” (top-left) to clear any old threads.
💬 Example: After you sign in, you’ll land on a clean chat window that looks like a blank notepad.

## Step 2 — Ask for a “story seed”
Type this exact prompt and press Enter:
> Give me three short story seeds: one with a surprising plot twist, one with a vivid character bio, and one with a rich setting prompt. Keep each under 50 words.

💬 Example:
> Give me three short story seeds: one with a surprising plot twist, one with a vivid character bio, and one with a rich setting prompt. Keep each under 50 words.

## Step 3 — Pick your favourite seed
DeepSeek will reply with three micro-ideas. Copy the one that gives you the strongest “what happens next?” feeling.
💬 Example reply you might see:
- Twist: A librarian discovers every book she touches rewrites itself overnight.
- Character: Maya, 12, speaks fluent dolphin but refuses to tell anyone why.
- Setting: A floating village where the houses drift on giant lily pads at dawn.

## Step 4 — Expand in the same chat
Ask DeepSeek to flesh out the seed you chose. Use one of these follow-ups:

For the twist:
> Expand the librarian story into a 100-word opening scene.

For the character:
> Write a 100-word scene showing Maya trying to hide her dolphin conversations from her parents.

For the setting:
> Describe the first hour of life in the floating village at sunrise.

💬 Example follow-up:
> Expand the librarian story into a 100-word opening scene.

## Step 5 — Save and tweak
Copy the expanded scene into your doc. Change any detail that doesn’t feel “you”—swap the librarian for a barista, or the lily pads for icebergs.
💬 Example tweak:
> Turn the librarian into a train-station café owner who notices the same book appearing on every passenger’s table.

## Common mistakes
- Asking for a whole novel instead of a seed—DeepSeek works best with bite-size prompts.
- Ignoring the word-limit hint—long prompts can confuse the model.
- Not copying the idea before closing the chat—your next session starts fresh.

## What this means for you
- **In everyday life:** Stuck on a birthday card message? Ask DeepSeek for a six-word story about the birthday person and paste it inside.
- **For your business or work:** Need a punchy product-launch hook? Request a twist, a character, and a setting in one go.
- **If you're just getting started:** Treat every chat as a “story vending machine”—type once, get three ideas, pick one, and keep typing.

## Try it now
Open [chat.deepseek.ai](https://chat.deepseek.ai), paste the prompt from Step 2, and copy the first seed that sparks your imagination. You’ll have your first 50 words in under two minutes.
